caption: Enicar Worldtimer, also known as the "Revolver Watch". A 1970s prototype; about five known. Six time displays on a revolver-cylinder mechanism. Came from the friend who bought two directly from Enicar's prototype watchmaker in Lengnau. (Summary; see the post for the owner's words.)
